attributes.action: Request for Fans in school classrooms
attributes.additional_details:
Children and school staff should have fans in their school classrooms 
It is not acceptable for people to struggle in a heatwave when we have things like fans available funding is not a good enough excuse in 2026
attributes.background: Fans should be placed by the government in Uk school classrooms

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
